dedupe_keys.name: average daily traffic counts 1972 to 2017 historical

description: Average Daily Traffic Counts 1972 to 2017 (Historical) is a dataset listed in City of Cambridge open data portal (data.cambridgema.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Cambridge. This dataset contains the Average Daily Traffic counts and AM and PM peak hour Traffic counts measured on various road segments in the City of Cambridge from 1972 to 2017. The counts in this data set reflect only vehicle counts. Coverage: Cambridge, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are traffic counts, vision zero. The table has 100 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Cambridge Traffic and Parking. The portal shows 2017-02-24 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cambridgema-gov-portal.
